chunks: And it has been narrated: “There is no day on which the sun rises that is better than the Day of Jumu‘ah.”
ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the virtue of the Day of Jumu‘ah?
ai.summary: This hadith states the excellence and superiority of the Day of Jumu‘ah over the other days. It highlights the special virtue of Friday in the Islamic tradition and supports its importance in acts of worship.
